instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In an indoor studio with a plain dusty pink background, two friends pose together happily. On the left, the curly-haired woman in a white button-down shirt (R1) smiles broadly directly at the camera. Behind her on the right, the straight-haired woman in a denim jacket (R2) stands laughing with squinted eyes, resting her right hand on the curly-haired woman's shoulder. Soft, warm studio lighting illuminates the scene, creating a gentle mood against the solid pastel pink backdrop.
